notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Temporal Manipulation and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Temporal Manipulation without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
